Sparse Voxel Octree Raycasting with Image Warping exploiting Frame-to-Frame Coherence The idea is to exploit temporal coherence between two consecutive rendered images to speed up ray-casting. The algorithm stores the x- y- and z-coordinate for each pixel in the scene in a coordinate-buffer and re-project it into the following screen using the differential view matrix.
